subject: Partitioned egress topology & SOC 2 evidence — request and delivery
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <security@veridian.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-23T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Request: partitioned egress topology + SOC 2 evidence for Dedicated/Private

Hi Jordan,

We're starting the network portion of Veridian's vendor assessment for Dedicated and Private deployments. To complete our SOC 2 / SIG review we need: 1) a clear network diagram showing how egress is partitioned between Dedicated and Private customer deployments (including NAT ranges, egress firewall clusters, and any shared egress proxies), 2) an explanation of where KMS/HSM keys are scoped (control plane vs. tenant-scoped), and 3) examples of the logs you capture (flow logs, audit logs) and retention periods.

Can you provide a short packet we can include in our auditor folder (diagram + SOC2 evidence checklist + CAIQ mapping for the network controls)? We have a tight window — auditors want this by end of next week (2026-07-30). Also please indicate whether Veridian would need any additional paperwork to request extended retention beyond the default.

Thanks — appreciate a quick ack and an ETA.

Olivia Chen
Security Program Manager
Veridian Health
security@veridian.com

Attachments: none

Acked. We'll assemble a focused evidence packet that includes: partitioned egress diagram, short narrative on control boundaries (KMS scoping + key custody), example flow and audit log exports (sanitized), and a filled SOC 2 evidence checklist plus a CAIQ mapping stub for network controls.

Proposed ETA: draft packet by 2026-07-24 (EOD), final by 2026-07-27 if you need us to iterate with auditors. If that works I'll schedule a 30-min walkthrough the morning of 2026-07-28 to run through the diagram and answer auditor Qs.

I'll loop in our security and infra folks and assign owners now.

—Jordan

Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-23T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Veridian request — partitioned egress packet (owners & action items)

Team — forwarding Veridian's ask. Quick assignment so we can hit 7/24 draft. Short, actionable items below.

Context: Veridian (external) is running auditors who want a SOC 2 / SIG packet focused on network isolation between Dedicated and Private deployments, with CAIQ mapping for network controls. They want a draft by 7/30; we should provide a draft earlier (7/24) for internal review.

Owners / actions:
- Marissa Cole: Produce the partitioned egress diagram (SVG/PNG). Show per-tenant NAT ranges for Dedicated vs Private, edge-relay firewall clusters per-region, shared service egress proxies, and where upstream cloud NAT occurs. Label control points and log collection points. (ETA: 2026-07-24 12:00 PDT)
- Kimberly Park: Prepare the SOC2 evidence checklist and CAIQ network-control mapping. Include short answers for network controls (AC-6 style tenant separation, boundary enforcement, egress filtering), reference to supporting artifacts (diagrams, log extracts). (ETA: 2026-07-24 EOD)
- Mateo Alvarez: Pull sanitized flow logs and an example audit-log export (redact account ids) and include retention settings. Provide exact IP ranges we advertise for per-tenant egress and a short note on how we rotate KMS keys and scope them. (ETA: 2026-07-24 10:30 PDT)

Notes / guidance: default log retention is 1 year in-hosted; for Dedicated/Private we support customer-requested extended retention (legal/contract needed for >3 years). KMS: control plane keys are managed by Redwood; tenant-scoped envelopes are possible in Private with customer-provided/customer-scoped keys (document all options). For per-tenant NAT we rely on isolated NAT namespaces for Dedicated pools and per-tenant SNAT translation on private enclaves — diagram should make this explicit.

Please reply-all with any blockers. I'll consolidate and send the draft to Olivia when we have the three artifacts.

—Jordan

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <security@veridian.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-24T14:17:00-07:00
Subject: Partitioned egress packet for Veridian — draft delivery

Hi Olivia — attaching the draft packet for your auditors. Attached files: partitioned-egress-diagram-v1.png (annotated), soc2-evidence-checklist.xlsx (filled for network controls), redwood-caiq-mapping-sample.pdf (network control mapping + references).

Key highlights (short answers to your questions):
- Partitioning model: Dedicated deployments are placed into reserved GPU pools with isolated tenant NAT namespaces (advertised egress blocks: 52.34.160.0/24 for dedicated-us-west, 52.34.161.0/24 for dedicated-us-east). Private deployments run in customer-managed VPCs with our private edge proxies; we publish per-deployment SNAT ranges on request (example shown in diagram).
- Egress enforcement: Egress is enforced at regional edge-relay firewall clusters (stateful firewall + IDS). Shared service traffic (metrics, telemetry) leaves via a controlled proxy cluster with mTLS to our ingestion endpoints.
- KMS scoping: Control-plane secrets are managed in Redwood KMS (HSM-backed). For Private deployments customers may bring their own KMS or request tenant-scoped key wrapping (we support envelope keying). See CAIQ answers for details and reference docs.
- Logs & retention: We capture VPC flow logs (sample provided), edge-relay access logs, and control-plane audit logs. Default retention: 1 year. Extended retention/longer archives available upon contractual addendum; we can push to customer-owned S3/GCS for longer holds.

Next steps: Please review the attached packet and let us know if auditors need any live artifacts (e.g., temporary read-only access to log slices) or a 30-minute walkthrough. We're available 2026-07-28 morning PT for a walkthrough.

Attachments (stubs):
- partitioned-egress-diagram-v1.png (PNG, 1.2MB) — shows per-tenant NAT ranges, edge-relay clusters, logging points, and KMS boundaries.
- soc2-evidence-checklist.xlsx (Excel) — checklist with references to included artifacts and owner notes.
- redwood-caiq-mapping-sample.pdf (PDF) — CAIQ network control mappings and short explanations.

Thanks — Jordan
Director, Solutions Architecture
